author: Cyrus
message:
Add issue templates for epic / feature / bug / design-question

Bare-bones issue-tracking scaffolding to support the pbjson-for-why /
deciduous-for-what / issues-for-how-and-when memory model. Templates
nudge each new issue toward its canonical shape: design questions
include options + blocked-by; epics include sub-issue checklists + open
questions; features include a parent-epic link.

config.yml disables blank issues and surfaces the live decision graph
viewer as a contact link.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>

author: Cyrus
message:
Install deciduous decision-graph harness and GitHub Pages deploy

Previously landed via local install but never committed. Adds:
- CLAUDE.md block documenting the graph workflow (inside deciduous
  start/end markers so future regenerations stay idempotent)
- .claude/ with commands (decision, recover, work, document, sync-graph,
  sync, serve-ui, build-test, decision-graph), hooks (require-action-node,
  post-commit-reminder), skills (pulse, narratives, archaeology),
  and an agents.toml scaffold
- .github/workflows for GitHub Pages deploy and decision-graph cleanup
- docs/ viewer assets (index.html + graph-data.json) for the live graph
- .gitignore: .deciduous/ (local DB), .claude/settings.local.json
  (machine-specific exomonad paths), and finally .DS_Store

No project-code changes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>
